text:
67세 남성 환자, ulcerative colitis acute exacerbation으로 입원함.   
Severe abdominal pain, bloody diarrhea, dehydration 호소함.  

BP 90/60 mmHg, HR 110 bpm, RR 24 breaths/min, BT 37.8°C, SpO2 95% on room air 확인됨.  

Hydrocortisone 100 mg IV q6h 투여함.  
IV fluid resuscitation 적용함.  

Negative fluid balance 확인됨.  
환자 alert 상태 유지함.
